# sonarqube_languages (Data Source)

Lists the languages the server's analyzers support, sorted by key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sonarqube_languages" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `search` (String) Pattern matched against language keys and names.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of this lookup in Terraform state.
- `languages` (Attributes List) Matching languages. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--languages))

<a id="nestedatt--languages"></a>
### Nested Schema for `languages`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) Language key.
- `name` (String) Language name.
